3: ¶ To the chief musician on Neginoth, Maschil, Psalm of David. Save me, O God, by your name, and judge me by your strength.
4: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
5: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
6: Behold, God is my helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
7: He shall reward evil to my enemies: cut them off in your truth.
8: I will freely sacrifice to you: I will praise your name, O LORD; for it is good.
9: For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has seen his desire on my enemies.
